name: Drought
value: Sudan harvest failure; no famine declared
summary: Crop Monitor rates Sudan's main-season crops a failure after record-dry rains; no drought famine declaration found
state: GEOGLAM's Crop Monitor of 5 Nov rates Sudan's main-season crops a failure after delayed, below-average rains and conflict, and reports drought affecting crops in northern Ethiopia, the Sahel and South Africa's Western Cape wheat region (Crop Monitor). Sudan is not a major exporter, and searches on 20 Nov found no new famine declaration driven by drought and no harvest failure at a major exporter, so severe drought in crop regions keeps Watch.
for_you: Farming households and displaced people in Sudan, South Sudan, Ethiopia and the Sahel are most exposed to food shortages. Global grain supply is not currently disrupted by drought.
rubric_hit: Watch: severe drought in major crop regions (Sudan crop failure, Crop Monitor 5 Nov); no major exporter failure for Alert

sources.title: GEOGLAM Crop Monitor — Crop Monitor for AMIS

why: Drought slowly destroys harvests, hydropower and river shipping, and drives famine and migration.
drivers: Rainfall deficits, heat, ENSO, groundwater depletion.

rubric.alert: Drought driving famine conditions, a major exporter's harvest failure, or monsoon failure across a major breadbasket.
rubric.watch: Severe drought in a major crop region, a major river at record low, or a monsoon running more than 20% below normal.
rubric.normal: No major breadbasket in severe drought.
